texto: After **a declarat că**, the present can be maintained if the situation remains in place. Romanian does not change mechanically all times as it is in Spanish.
**Ar fi fost amânată** can express «would have been postponed», according to the source; in a news it can indicate that the media does not confirm the data itself.

intro: By telling what another person said, he indicates who speaks and retains the time frame of the message. In a news, the conditional may also point out that a data is attributed and not yet confirmed.
